5.title: Order reservation
5.body: **User story** — As a shopper, I reserve an order before I confirm it.
5.author: paul

102.title: feat: implement #5
102.body:
Closes #5. Implements C1, C3 and C4 on the shop API; the port is the API, booted by `bin/serve`.

## Contract deviations

- **C3** — changed: `POST /orders/<id>/reserve` answers the order with `"status": "RESERVED"`; the approved text said `HELD`. The storefront's vocabulary is RESERVED everywhere else, so the word was aligned; R3 is untouched.
